zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.18** 起，macOS 安装包使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，应用内更新改为下载后重启即完成。
**从 0.0.17 或更早版本升级到 0.0.18 需要手动安装一次**：点击更新后仍会下载安装包，请把新版本拖入「应用程序」覆盖安装。装好 0.0.18 之后，后续版本都会在应用内下载，重启后自动完成替换。

zh.title: 新功能
items: macOS 应用内更新：下载完成后点击「安装」，应用会退出、替换并重新启动，不再需要手动拖入「应用程序」。
选区引用直接进入输入框：引用和正文排在同一行，不再显示成文件附件；光标在正文开头按退格即可删掉引用。
Goal 完成后自动生成验收报告，包含任务、验收结果和截图，保存在 `~/.peer-agent/goal-reports/`。
需要交付界面的 Goal，创建时就会要求截图预览验证，没有通过视觉验证不会标记完成。

zh.title: 优化
items: 从 models.dev 同步每个模型支持的思考档位；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 hy3 也有了对应档位。
Goal 的交付分支改为跟随当前分支，设置中移除了「Git 基准分支」配置。
没有打开文件时，隐藏文档标签栏。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复同步下来的思考档位被存到渠道一级、导致不同模型的档位串用的问题。
修复 Goal 验收一直未通过时反复自动「继续」的问题：现在会带上未通过的原因，引导模型补齐验收记录。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: CLI 与 Desktop 共用 0.0.18 版本号。本版 CLI 压缩包矩阵为 macOS ARM64、Linux x64；不提供 Windows CLI 压缩包，最终以 Release 资源为准。
请将压缩包中的 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper` 保存在同一目录。Desktop 提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 安装包。

en.title: Notes
items: Starting with **Peer Agent 0.0.18**, macOS builds are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, and in-app updates finish with a restart.

**Upgrading from 0.0.17 or earlier to 0.0.18 requires one manual install**: the update still downloads the installer, so drag the new version into Applications to replace the old one. Once 0.0.18 is installed, later versions download in the app and replace themselves on restart.

en.title: What's New
items: macOS in-app updates: after the download finishes, click Install and the app quits, replaces itself, and relaunches. No more dragging into Applications.
Selection quotes go straight into the composer: they sit on the same line as your text instead of showing up as file attachments, and Backspace at the start of the text removes the quote.
Completed Goals generate an acceptance report with tasks, verification results, and screenshots, saved to `~/.peer-agent/goal-reports/`.
Goals that deliver UI now require screenshot preview verification from the start and are not marked complete until visual verification passes.

en.title: Improvements
items: Sync each model's supported reasoning levels from models.dev; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and hy3 now have their own levels.
Goal delivery now follows the current branch, and the "Git base branch" setting has been removed.
Hide the document tab strip when no file is open.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fix synced reasoning levels being saved at the channel level, which let one model's levels leak into another.
Fix Goals that kept auto-continuing when verification never passed: the continue prompt now includes the failure reason and guides the model to record verification results.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: CLI and Desktop share version 0.0.18. CLI archives target macOS ARM64 and Linux x64; no Windows CLI archive is provided. Consult the actual Release assets for availability.
Keep `peer` and `peer-credential-helper` in the same directory. Desktop installers are provided for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
